_note: Condition keys as the harness writes them into records, with the paper's names (renamed 2026-10-23; `aliases` are the earlier names, still understood everywhere a record or a flag names a condition). Edit `name` to rename everywhere (report.py, serve.py, paper.py, figures.ts, the viewer read this).

conditions.name: one-shot
conditions.what: the model writes the whole LDraw file once, with no environment

conditions.name: one-shot+feedback
conditions.what: up to four files; the validator's report pasted back as text between them

conditions.name: interactive
conditions.what: builds piece by piece in the environment, in the connection language; each placement is checked as it is made, the finished build never verified

conditions.name: interactive+final check
conditions.what: interactive, plus the validator when the agent declares completion, with two repair rounds per gate

conditions.name: interactive+check tools
conditions.what: interactive+final check, plus the validator as tools the agent may call during the build

models._note: The model ids the environment accepts (lib/copilot/types.ts COPILOT_MODELS); any other id silently falls back to claude-sonnet-5 there. The paper used claude-opus-5. The ldraw conditions call the Anthropic API directly, so the gemini id does not apply to them.
